content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. LXXXIX.—वादे &c. and विनीतोचिता are taken together by", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "the commentators. But there does seem to be some little in-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 3, "text": "compatibility between the two. I would suggest that they be", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "taken separately as designating two different descriptions of विद्या", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "corresponding to the two uses mentioned in the familiar Stanza", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "विद्या विवादाय धनं मदाय &c. Râmarshi takes अधररस as equivalent", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "to अधर एव रसः; wrongly, I think; अधरस्य रसः is more usual and", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "better.—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XC.—Vans'astha.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XCI.—जीर्ण=वृद्ध. (Râmarshi) but it means absorbed as in St.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "2. For the second line also comp. St. 2. हा is better than ह्य़ा in", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "the fourth line. With ह्या, आ might be taken as standing by itself,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "it being the आ which is स्मरणे. A curious variant for वन्ध्य", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "is विन्ध्य which Râmarshi comments on, though in the copy we", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "have, the text is written वन्ध्य. He says विन्ध्याचलफलतुल्यत्वं याताः", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "प्राप्ताः। विन्ध्याचलस्य हि अतिगहनत्वेन मनुष्याणां दुःसंचारत्वात् अनेकानि फलानि", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "अनुपभोग्यत्वान्निरर्थकानि भवन्ति.—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r6", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XCII.—वलित=मिश्रित (Râmarshi.) Comp. Mâlatî-Mâdhava", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "अमृतसंवलितैरिवाङ्गैः (p. 152). People misunderstand the mere cure of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "pain as itself a pleasure.—S'ikhariṇî.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r7", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XCIII.—आत्मनि ब्रह्मणि त्वयि आसमन्ताद्भावेन रामः क्रीडा यस्य स तथा", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "स्वात्मानुभवसंपन्न इत्यर्थः (Râmarshi). At Gîtâ V., 24 where the ex-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 3, "text": "pression अन्तरारामः occurs. S'ankara explains it by अन्तरेवात्मन्यारामः", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "क्रीडा यस्य सः. After giving the ordinary meaning of फलाशी Râmar-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 5, "text": "shi says अथवा फले मोक्षलक्षणे आशा वाञ्छा विद्यते यस्य स तथा. On समकर-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 6, "text": "चरणे which is Râmarshi's reading he writes समकरचरणो हि पुमान्धन-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 7, "text": "वान्भवतीति सामुद्रिके प्रसिद्धम् and also मत्स्यांकितचरणो हि पुमान्धनवान्भवतीत्यपि", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "the latter being required for the alternative meaning of मकरेण", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "सहितौ चरणौ and not समौ करचरणौ यस्य.—Sragdharâ.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r8", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XCIV.—ननु is अवधारणे.
